# Meet a scientist: B. G. L. Swamy

<!-- STEP id="who" -->
## An Indian botanist

B. G. L. Swamy was a well-known Indian **botanist**, a scientist who studies plants. He is known for his work on plant **morphology**, the outer form of plants, and plant **anatomy**, the inner structure of plants.

<!-- STEP id="his-book" -->
## A book in Kannada

He wrote a popular book in the Kannada language called *Hasuru Honnu*. It describes a plant-study trip through the forests of the Western Ghats, and it mixes science with humour and culture. The book is full of:

- descriptions of plants and their uses
- ways people protect plants
- old stories and beliefs about plants

<!-- STEP id="award" -->
## An award

**In 1978, *Hasuru Honnu* won the Kendra Sahitya Akademi Award.**
